messages:
Maria (Support): FYI escalation from Support — onboarding call with VoltaPay just ended, they sent multiple short voice notes showing SDK auth failures and 401 spikes. Need CS handoff, looks like renewal at risk.
Alex (CSM): @maria.support can you paste the customer id + which env (prod/stage) and attach the audio links? any error ids?
Maria (Support): customer_id=volta-01, failing in staging then repro in prod. Audio links: https://files.redwood/volta/voice1.mp3 , https://files.redwood/volta/voice2.mp3
Maria (Support): quick note: they hit ~40% failed calls in a 10m window after key rotation at 09:02 UTC, errors are "401 unauthorized" with token invalidation.
Jordan (CSE): Likely cause: key rotation propagated but SDK cached old token. Quick mitigation: ask them to force a client restart or clear SDK cache; I'll add a server-side short-term fallback for 30m to accept previous token for this tenant while they update clients.
Jordan (CSE): logs snippet: ```
2026-03-21T09:04:12Z volta-01 auth: token_expired for key k_abc123
2026-03-21T09:04:13Z volta-01 request_id=rx-77a status=401
```
Alex (CSM): Good — @jordan.cse can you open an ops ticket for the fallback and estimated rollback time? I want to tell the customer an exact ETA.
Jordan (CSE): opened INC-2026-5891, fallback in place in 6m, will monitor, rollback plan ready if no improvement by +30m.
Maria (Support): Adding the transcribed snippets from audio: "app shows unauthorized, tried to regen token, still same, onboarding demo broke" — customer pretty upset.
Priya (CS): I'll join the call w/ VoltaPay at 10:00 local to acknowledge and share comms. Drafted a short comms plan: 1) immediate apology + mitigation steps, 2) timeline for fix (6m fallback), 3) follow-up postmortem within 48h, 4) credit for missed demo if confirmed. I'll DM the draft to @alex.csm for approval.
Alex (CSM): Please include renewal-owner note and flag as "at-risk" in the account health dashboard. I'll prep a short exec summary.
Maria (Support): Also capturing customer feedback: they want an "undo" option for recent key rotations and clearer retry guidance in SDK. I've logged feature request FR-421 in Support backlog.
Alex (CSM): Thanks team. @maria.support please paste any raw audio attachments into the case and set severity=urgent. I'll take lead on the 10:00 customer touchpoint. :thumbsup:
ops-deploy-bot: Ticket INC-2026-5891 created and linked to VOLTA-01. Monitor set for 15s.
Jordan (CSE): fallback active now, seeing failed rate drop from 41% -> 3% in the last 2m. continuing to watch.
Alex (CSM): Great — I'll send the comms and update renewal risk. follow-ups: postmortem + SDK retry doc update assigned after incident.
Maria (Support): Closing loop here on Slack, will keep updates in the ticket.
